meaning.en: A customer who comes back again and again.
meaning.zh: 指再次光顾、经常来买东西的顾客。

examples.zh: 这家小店靠回头客撑了二十年。
examples.en: This little shop has survived twenty years on repeat customers.

examples.zh: 好服务才能留住回头客。
examples.en: Good service is what keeps customers coming back.

usage.en: Business talk; a measure of shop quality.
usage.zh: 多用于商业场合，是衡量店铺口碑的标准。

meaning.en: To act humble and submissive, often to avoid trouble or to get something.
meaning.zh: 故意装出低声下气、听话示弱的样子。

examples.zh: 他在老板面前装孙子，背后却骂个不停。
examples.en: He grovels before the boss and curses him behind his back.

examples.zh: 别跟我装孙子，有话直说。
examples.en: Don't act all meek with me; say what you mean.

usage.en: Rude, colloquial; 孙子 (grandson) is the lowly junior. Not to be confused with the insult 孙子.
usage.zh: 口语，较粗俗。“孙子”指晚辈，地位低。

meaning.en: A person who calculates meticulously and never lets money slip.
meaning.zh: 形容精于计算、一分钱也不肯吃亏的人。

examples.zh: 他是出了名的铁算盘，账目一点错不了。
examples.en: He's a famous penny-counter; his accounts are never wrong.

examples.zh: 跟铁算盘做生意，你占不到便宜。
examples.en: You won't get the better of such a shrewd dealer.

usage.en: Describes a person; can be admiring or mildly mocking.
usage.zh: 指人，可褒可贬。

meaning.en: Words that go in one ear and out the other; advice that is ignored.
meaning.zh: 比喻听了不放在心上的话。

equivalents: go in one ear and out the other

examples.zh: 我的劝告他全当耳边风。
examples.en: He treated all my advice as so much wind.

examples.zh: 父母的话不能当耳边风。
examples.en: You mustn't brush off your parents' words.

usage.en: Usually 当/成耳边风; also 当耳旁风.
usage.zh: 常说“当耳边风”，也说“当耳旁风”。

meaning.en: A surprise counter-move made when the other side thinks you are retreating.
meaning.zh: 比喻突然转身反击或再次出现。

examples.zh: 他假装离开，突然杀个回马枪。
examples.en: He pretended to leave, then suddenly doubled back.

examples.zh: 警察杀了个回马枪，当场抓住小偷。
examples.en: The police doubled back and caught the thief red-handed.

usage.en: Usually 杀回马枪. Image: a rider in flight wheeling to thrust his spear at the pursuer.
usage.zh: 常说“杀回马枪”。原指骑马佯退，突然回身刺杀追兵。

meaning.en: To make big claims or threats that are never carried out.
meaning.zh: 说大话、说了不做，不兑现。

examples.zh: 他老是放空炮，从来没见他做成过什么。
examples.en: He's all talk; I've never seen him accomplish anything.

examples.zh: 别光放空炮，拿出行动来。
examples.en: Stop firing blanks and show some action.

usage.en: Casual criticism of boasting.
usage.zh: 口语，批评只说不做。

meaning.en: To abandon one's work halfway, leaving others in the lurch.
meaning.zh: 比喻把担负的工作丢下不干。

examples.zh: 项目最紧张的时候，他突然撂挑子走人。
examples.en: At the busiest point of the project he suddenly walked out.

examples.zh: 你可不能半路撂挑子。
examples.en: You can't just drop the load halfway.

usage.en: Image: a porter dropping his shoulder-pole load. Often in work contexts.
usage.zh: 原指挑担的人把担子放下不挑，多用于工作场合。

meaning.en: To travel from place to place earning a living, as a performer, peddler or the like.
meaning.zh: 指四处奔走谋生，如卖艺、做买卖。

examples.zh: 他年轻时跑过江湖，见多识广。
examples.en: He roamed the country in his youth and has seen a lot.

examples.zh: 爷爷跑江湖卖艺养活一家人。
examples.en: Grandpa fed the family as a travelling performer.

usage.en: Implies an itinerant, rough life and street-smarts.
usage.zh: 暗示漂泊辛苦、见过世面。

meaning.en: A person or thing one cannot stand and wishes to be rid of.
meaning.zh: 比喻最痛恨、非除去不可的人或事。

examples.zh: 他把对手看作肉中刺。
examples.en: He saw his rival as a thorn in his flesh.

examples.zh: 这个小店成了大公司的肉中刺。
examples.en: The little shop became a thorn in the big firm's side.

usage.en: Often paired with 眼中钉: 眼中钉、肉中刺.
usage.zh: 常与“眼中钉”连用。

meaning.en: The second-to-last item on a programme, the highlight; the climax of an event.
meaning.zh: 原指戏曲演出中倒数第二个节目，常是精彩所在；比喻最精彩的部分。

examples.zh: 今晚的压轴戏是一场魔术表演。
examples.en: Tonight's highlight is a magic show.

examples.zh: 决赛是整个运动会的压轴戏。
examples.en: The final is the main event of the whole sports meet.

usage.en: In opera the very last item is 大轴, the one before is 压轴; today 压轴 means 'the high point'.
usage.zh: 戏曲中最后一出叫“大轴”，倒数第二出为“压轴”，现泛指最精彩的部分。

meaning.en: To attack or slander someone secretly from behind.
meaning.zh: 比喻暗中伤人。

examples.zh: 他不敢正面批评，只会背后放冷箭。
examples.en: He dares not criticise openly and only shoots from the shadows.

examples.zh: 要小心有人放冷箭。
examples.en: Watch out for someone taking a cheap shot.

usage.en: A hidden arrow is hard to dodge. Also 暗箭伤人.
usage.zh: 暗处射来的箭难以防备，也说“暗箭伤人”。

meaning.en: To be visibly furious: puffing at one's whiskers and glaring.
meaning.zh: 形容生气、发怒的样子。

examples.zh: 他气得吹胡子瞪眼，却说不出话来。
examples.en: He fumed and glared but couldn't say a word.

examples.zh: 有话好好说，别吹胡子瞪眼的。
examples.en: Speak calmly, don't puff and glare.

usage.en: Stock image of an angry old man; used humorously for any angry person.
usage.zh: 典型的老头生气模样，现也幽默地形容任何发怒的人。

meaning.en: A person who secretly passes information to someone, especially a boss.
meaning.zh: 指暗中向人传递消息的人。

examples.zh: 领导的耳报神太多，大家说话都谨慎。
examples.en: The boss has so many informants that everyone chooses words carefully.

examples.zh: 他在办公室里有个耳报神。
examples.en: He has a mole in the office.

usage.en: Also used humorously for a lucky tip-off.
usage.zh: 有时也半开玩笑指消息灵通。

meaning.en: To talk in an affected, put-on manner.
meaning.zh: 说话故意装腔作势，不自然。

examples.zh: 他一上台就拿腔拿调，听着真别扭。
examples.en: The moment he is on stage he turns affected, which is awkward to hear.

examples.zh: 有话好好说，别拿腔拿调的。
examples.en: Speak normally, no affectation.

usage.en: Often 拿腔拿调地说话. Can describe officials or stagey speech.
usage.zh: 常说“拿腔拿调地说”，可指官腔或做作的腔调。

natural: scribble away; write for a living

meaning.en: A humorous way of saying 'to write', especially as a profession.
meaning.zh: 幽默地指写作，多指以写作为业。

examples.zh: 他爬了三十年格子，才出了第一本书。
examples.en: He scribbled for thirty years before his first book.

examples.zh: 我这个爬格子的，最怕截稿日期。
examples.en: As a writer, I dread deadlines most.

usage.en: From manuscript paper printed with squares (稿纸). Self-deprecating.
usage.zh: 来自方格稿纸，常带自嘲。

natural: unable to put food on the table

meaning.en: So poor that there is nothing to cook.
meaning.zh: 穷得没米下锅，生活无着。

examples.zh: 那年大旱，不少人家都揭不开锅了。
examples.en: In the drought year, many families had nothing to cook.

examples.zh: 他们家早就揭不开锅了。
examples.en: Their family had long had nothing in the pot.

usage.en: Used for severe poverty; often 眼看就要揭不开锅.
usage.zh: 形容极度贫困。

meaning.en: Something that restores confidence or morale.
meaning.zh: 比喻能给人信心和鼓舞的事物。

examples.zh: 这场胜利是对球队的一剂强心剂。
examples.en: This win is a shot in the arm for the team.

examples.zh: 政府出台新政，给经济打了一针强心剂。
examples.en: The new policy gave the economy a shot in the arm.

usage.en: Usually 打一针/一剂强心剂; from the medical cardiac stimulant.
usage.zh: 常说“打一针强心剂”，本是治疗心力衰竭的药物。

meaning.en: A way of running things where one person has the sole say.
meaning.zh: 指个人说了算、不听别人意见的作风。

examples.zh: 公司不能搞一言堂。
examples.en: A company must not be run by one man's word.

examples.zh: 他的一言堂作风让大家很有意见。
examples.en: His dictatorial style upsets everyone.

usage.en: Contrast the saying 群言堂 (everyone gets a say). Often 搞一言堂.
usage.zh: 反义词为“群言堂”，常说“搞一言堂”。

meaning.en: To put a damaging label on someone without good grounds.
meaning.zh: 比喻不分青红皂白给人加上罪名或坏标签。

examples.zh: 讨论问题要讲理，不要乱扣帽子。
examples.en: Discuss with reason; don't slap labels around.

examples.zh: 他被扣上了一顶“守旧”的帽子。
examples.en: He got branded as old-fashioned.

usage.en: Often 乱扣帽子 or 扣上一顶……的帽子.
usage.zh: 常说“乱扣帽子”。

meaning.en: A set of interlocking schemes, each making the next work.
meaning.zh: 指一环扣一环、环环相扣的计策。

examples.zh: 这是一条精心设计的连环计。
examples.en: This is a carefully designed chain of schemes.

examples.zh: 对手使出连环计，我们防不胜防。
examples.en: The rival used a chain of ploys we could not guard against.

usage.en: One of the Thirty-Six Stratagems (第三十五计); famous from Three Kingdoms, where Diaochan is used to set Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu against each other.
usage.zh: 三十六计之一，《三国演义》中王允、貂蝉离间董卓、吕布最为有名。

meaning.en: To suffer a setback or failure, as if taking a fall.
meaning.zh: 比喻遭受挫折或失败。

examples.zh: 他在股市栽了个大跟头。
examples.en: He took a big tumble on the stock market.

examples.zh: 别以为自己了不起，小心栽跟头。
examples.en: Don't think you're great; you'll come a cropper.

usage.en: Usually 栽了个跟头. Compare 摔跟头, which is more literal.
usage.zh: 常说“栽了个大跟头”。

meaning.en: To drink alone and in low spirits.
meaning.zh: 心情不好时一个人闷闷地喝酒。

examples.zh: 他失业后天天在家喝闷酒。
examples.en: Since losing his job he drinks gloomily at home every day.

examples.zh: 别一个人喝闷酒，出来聊聊吧。
examples.en: Don't drink alone and sulk; come out and talk.

usage.en: Implies unhappiness rather than socialising.
usage.zh: 含有心情苦闷之意，不同于聚饮。

meaning.en: To signal someone with the eyes, without speaking.
meaning.zh: 用眼神向人示意。

equivalents: give a signal with the eyes

examples.zh: 他给我递了个眼色，让我别说话。
examples.en: He gave me a look telling me to keep quiet.

examples.zh: 两人暗中递眼色，不让别人看见。
examples.en: The two exchanged glances so nobody would notice.

usage.en: Usually 递个眼色; 使眼色 is an equally common form.
usage.zh: 常说“递个眼色”，近义“使眼色”。
